faq.q: How do I get a clip from a product page?
faq.a: Paste the public product page, pick an AI actor, approve the script, and download the clip. The photo on that page is the product in the file.

faq.q: Do I pay credits to start a clip from my product page?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost before it runs, and a failed render returns those credits.

faq.q: What clips can I post from one product link?
faq.a: A listing video, a product demo, a paid ad, or a social clip. Each one can use the photo and the facts already on that public page.

faq.q: Can I use the clip for ads, the product page, and social posts?
faq.a: Yes. Shops use it for ads, product pages, and social posts. You approve the script before the file is downloaded.

faq.q: Can I change the drafted script before the clip is made?
faq.a: Yes. Read the script, change any line that does not match the listing, and then render. The wording stays yours.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths can I download?
faq.a: Yes. You download a video file. Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: What do I get after I paste the product page?
faq.a: The photo and the written facts come in from that page. You get a draft script, then you pick an actor and a voice before the clip is made.

faq.q: Do I need editing experience for the first clip?
faq.a: No. You can still open the editor if you want to trim the clip, change the music, or fix a line. A first clip does not require that.

faq.q: Which product pages can I paste to start a clip?
faq.a: Yes. Public product pages a shopper can open without logging in. A locked page or a page with no product photo will not supply the picture.

faq.q: Why start from the listing instead of gathering the files myself?
faq.a: The page already has the product photo and the facts you would otherwise retype. You spend the time on the script and the actor.

faq.q: How do I go from the product link to a clip I can post?
faq.a: Paste the link, approve the script, and start the render. You see the credit cost first. There is no separate shoot to schedule before that.

faq.q: How long do I wait for the clip?
faq.a: The render starts after you approve the script and the actor. If it fails, the credits for that job come back.

faq.q: How do I turn a product listing into an ad I can run?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the listing, pick a tall or square frame, approve the spoken line, and download. The file has no watermark and can run as an ad.
